description: Views and materialized views catalogue scenarios
comment: Table-driven pack for Views and materialized views. Shared project template; each scenario overlays one declarative file.

scenarios.description: apply view.create with a native in-place operation
scenarios.comment: Covers PG-CAT-VIW-01::view.create. Keep public.transition_anchor identity stable.

requiredMigrationPatterns.description: emits native DDL rather than recreating the anchor

forbiddenMigrationPatterns.description: does not replace the transition anchor

scenarios.description: treat view.rename as an identity-unsafe drop/create pair without a rename hint
scenarios.comment: Covers PG-CAT-VIW-01::view.rename. Keep public.transition_anchor identity stable. PostgreSQL RENAME/SET SCHEMA preserves OIDs; an unhinted declarative pair must not silently drop data.
